title: Generator extracts speakable text with ignore rules
description:
## Behavior
```gherkin
Feature: Content generator
  Scenario: Ignore marked regions
    Given a page with a nav marked data-auritus-ignore and an article paragraph
    When the generator runs
    Then the TTS input string includes the article text
    And excludes the nav text
  Scenario: Pronounce and break markup
    Given text with data-auritus-pronounce and data-auritus-break
    When the generator runs
    Then pronounce replacements and break markers appear in the TTS input
```

## Implementation brief
1. embed/src/generator/index.ts — DOM walk, ignore selectors + data-auritus-ignore, pronounce/break.
2. Acceptance: vitest scenarios in embed/tests/generator.test.ts.
right_now_summary: The generator is being built to extract speakable text while ignoring marked regions and applying pronunciation and
